records.summary: Quipu is a governed, bitemporal knowledge store with provenance and SPARQL access through command-line, REST, Rust library and MCP interfaces.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fsharing%2Findex.md
records.summary: Repository pendants transfer source-bound knowledge between stores through explicit quarantine and promotion, keeping transport separate from receiver authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Fmain.rs
records.summary: The native command-line entrypoint parses local query, share, import and validation commands.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/quipu/src%2Flib.rs
records.summary: The Rust library exposes the embedded graph engine used by native clients and repository integrations.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fgetting-started%2Fagent-setup.md#local-stdio-mcp
records.summary: Local agent clients run quipu mcp over stdio with explicit executable and database paths; it launches the matching sibling server without an HTTP listener.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/quipu/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fsharing%2Findex.md
records.summary: Imported knowledge stays staged until explicit promotion. Bundled shapes and source evidence are not automatic receiver authority.
